groupings.title: Get a code
groupings.description: Three ways your agent can produce a valid 2FA code on demand — offline from a seed you hold, over MCP from a server you run, or from the vault that already holds it.

groupings.title: Keep it safe, then use it
groupings.description: Where the seed and the backup codes live so they never reach git, and how to spend a code on a real login without locking the account.
